scope: Independent read-only shard parser and bounded-header review; not a formal proof or whole-project audit.

findings: Array-value reservation preflight compared the minimum encoded bytes with remaining file bytes but not the remaining metadata budget.
Tensor descriptor reservation occurred before proving the remaining file/header budget could contain even the smallest legal descriptor.
reviews.other_observations: No unsafe, direct malformed-input index panic, shard ownership or transactional-construction bypass found in the reviewed scope.

reviews.stage: Allocation correction and reader domain review
reviews.result: Both narrow findings closed; small-budget tests target the early errors.
observations: minimum_encoded checks both remaining physical bytes and cumulative header budget before array/descriptor reservation.
Scalar dimensions default to one, zero extents preserve sequential source checks, empty-directory data offset and descriptor-order padded offsets match the frozen source.
Rust UTF-8/NUL-name restrictions remain a documented stricter domain; no extra native malformed-name acceptance claim.
Refill capped to remaining physical bytes and cumulative header allowance.
Consumed position remains in the initial bounded range.
Short reads and interrupted read_exact behavior remain valid.
finish executes after parse success/error, restores the consumed position, and preserves an original parse error if synchronization also fails.

negative_control: allocation-negative-result.json; both preflight tests fail with only the early preflight calls removed.
